name: Sahara Khatun
contribution: Acted as a senior civilian crisis interlocutor in negotiations and public communication.
context: Government response to the Pilkhana hostage and mutiny situation.
impact: Her role represented the civilian chain of command during negotiations.
highlight: Sahara Khatun served as Home Minister during the February 2009 Pilkhana crisis and its negotiations.
seoTitle: Sahara Khatun: Civilian Response to the Pilkhana Crisis
seoDescription: A contextual profile of Sahara Khatun's role as Home Minister during the 2009 Pilkhana mutiny and hostage crisis.
shortAnswer: Sahara Khatun was Bangladesh's Home Minister during the 2009 Pilkhana crisis and part of the civilian response.
